name: Configuration Drift Monitoring
description: Continuously monitors agent, tool, and MCP server configurations for drift from established baselines. Detects unauthorized changes, misconfigurations, and security degradation over time.
threat_addressed: Configuration drift is a leading cause of security incidents — settings change incrementally through updates, manual interventions, or compromise until the actual configuration no longer matches the intended security posture. In agent environments, drift can silently expand agent permissions, weaken encryption, or disable controls.
enforcement_mechanism: Compares current configuration state against stored baselines at each evaluation cycle. Detects additions, removals, and modifications to security-relevant settings. Generates drift reports with severity classification.

security_outcome.pass: Configuration stable — no drift from established baseline.
security_outcome.fail: Configuration drift detected — current state differs from baseline.

display_detail: Monitors agent and tool configurations for drift from established security baselines.
remediation_hint_template: Configuration drift detected. Compare current configuration against baseline and authorize or revert changes.
